# .40 Imperial Diet of Homage
oe_sub.40 = {
    type = country_event
    outcome = positive
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v180_io_grand_council.dds"
    title = oe_sub.40.t
    desc = oe_sub.40.d

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = { any_subject = { liberty_desire >= 50 } }
            random_subject = {
                limit = { liberty_desire >= 50 }
                save_scope_as = oe_sub_plotter
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_sub_plotter }
                set_variable = { name = oe_sub_diet_suspect value = scope:oe_sub_plotter }
            }
        }
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_sub.40.a
        ai_chance = { base = 55 }
        add_prestige = 5
        every_subject = {
            limit = { liberty_desire < 50 }
            add_liberty_desire = -5
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_diet_suspect }
            var:oe_sub_diet_suspect ?= {
                add_liberty_desire = -10
                add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_sub_b_diet_reprimand }
            }
            remove_variable = oe_sub_diet_suspect
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_diet_subject } remove_variable = oe_sub_diet_subject }
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_sub.40.b
        trigger = { gold >= 60 }
        ai_chance = { base = 25 }
        add_gold = -60
        every_subject = {
            add_liberty_desire = -8
            add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_sub_b_diet_homage }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_diet_suspect } remove_variable = oe_sub_diet_suspect }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_diet_subject } remove_variable = oe_sub_diet_subject }
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_sub.40.c
        ai_chance = { base = 20 }
        add_legitimacy = 5
        add_prestige = 3
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_imperial_diet_authority years = 5 mode = replace }
        every_subject = { add_liberty_desire = 3 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_diet_suspect } remove_variable = oe_sub_diet_suspect }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_diet_subject } remove_variable = oe_sub_diet_subject }
    }
}

# .55 Vassal Heir Homecoming from Imperial Court
oe_sub.55 = {
    type = country_event
    outcome = positive
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/institutions/legalism.dds"
    title = oe_sub.55.t
    desc = oe_sub.55.d

    option = {
        name = oe_sub.55.a
        ai_chance = { base = 75 }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_returning_ward }
            var:oe_sub_returning_ward ?= {
                add_adm = 3
                add_dip = 3
                add_mil = 3
                remove_character_modifier = oe_sub_hostage_at_court_char
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { culture = root.culture } }
                    random = {
                        chance = 50
                        change_character_culture = root.culture
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_hostage_home }
                    var:oe_sub_hostage_home ?= { save_scope_as = oe_sub_ret_home }
                    if = {
                        limit = { exists = scope:oe_sub_ret_home scope:oe_sub_ret_home = { num_locations > 0 } }
                        move_country = scope:oe_sub_ret_home
                        scope:oe_sub_ret_home = {
                            add_liberty_desire = -15
                            add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_sub_b_ward_homecoming }
                            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_court_educated_bond years = 15 mode = replace }
                        }
                    }
                    remove_variable = oe_sub_hostage_home
                }
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_hostage_overlord } remove_variable = oe_sub_hostage_overlord }
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_hostage_return_m } remove_variable = oe_sub_hostage_return_m }
            }
            remove_variable = oe_sub_returning_ward
        }
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_sub.55.b
        ai_chance = { base = 25 }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_returning_ward }
            var:oe_sub_returning_ward ?= {
                add_dip = 4
                set_variable = { name = oe_sub_hostage_return_m value = oe_sub_m_plus36 }
                add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_hostage_at_court_char years = 3 mode = replace }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_hostage_home }
                    var:oe_sub_hostage_home ?= {
                        add_liberty_desire = 6
                    }
                }
            }
            remove_variable = oe_sub_returning_ward
        }
    }
}
